text:
```yaml
name: Auto-Close Unready PRs

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  check-and-close-unready-prs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run script to check and close unready PRs
        run: |
          python scripts/auto_close_unready_prs.py
```
